slo_title: Identify dynamic memory allocation strategies for objects and messages

mcq.q: Which data structure is typically used in dynamic memory allocation?
What is dynamic memory allocation in object-oriented programming?

options.A: a) Allocating memory at compile time
options.B: b) Allocating memory at runtime as needed
options.C: c) Fixed memory allocation before execution ​​​​​
options.D: d) Memory that is never released

mcq.answer_text: b) Allocating memory at runtime as needed

mcq.q: Why is dynamic dispatch slower than direct call?

options.B: b) It requires resolving the method at runtime through a virtual table (vtable)
options.D: d) It runs outside of memory

mcq.answer_text: b) It requires resolving the method at runtime through a virtual table (vtable)

mcq.q: In Java, which keyword is commonly used to allocate memory dynamically for an object?
Which of the following is a performance benefit of direct procedure calls over dynamic dispatch?

options.A: a) Requires multiple virtual table lookups
options.C: c) Enables faster execution due to compile-time binding ​​​​​

mcq.answer_text: c) Enables faster execution due to compile-time binding ​​​​​

sq.q: A performance audit reveals delays in frequently called functions. What role do method call overheads play in this performance issue?
answer: Dynamic dispatch in object-oriented languages introduces runtime overhead due to method resolution, whereas static calls in procedural code are resolved at compile time, offering better performance.

sq.q: A large-scale e-commerce platform requires maintainable and extensible code. Why is object-oriented programming more suitable than procedural for this case?
answer: Object-oriented programming promotes abstraction, encapsulation, and reuse, allowing complex systems to be broken down into manageable components with clear responsibilities.
